messages:
Maya R.: Heads-up: we're starting a small compliance pilot for Private/VPC customers next week to test automated evidence collection and attestation generation. Need signoff on the prep checklist by EOD.

Infra-Bot: SCHEDULED: compliance-pilot kickoff window 2068001234 -> 2068001290. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/compliance-pilot (internal).

Jonas T.: Which artifacts are we collecting? customers will ask.

Asha V.: Minimal set: config snapshot, agent heartbeat, cert chain, recent logs (48-72h). For on-prem air-gapped installs we'll accept offline bundles. Retention for pilot artifacts: 30 days.

Legal-Bot: Reminder: do not present this as a SOC 2 attestation to customers yet. Use pilot wording only. NDA + consent required for cohort participants.

Maya R.: Thanks team — eng-ops please coordinate the canary rollout and post status to #private-deployments-status after the Friday window. Tag me for any legal or infra blockers.
